Video playback plumbing for <media-figure>: lazy <source>

UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

ensureVideoSource

Sets the src on a video element when it becomes playable.

playVideo

Starts muted playback honoring reduced-motion/autoplay prefs.

pauseVideo

Pauses playback (offscreen or pref change).

syncVideoPlayback

Store change → start/stop playback to match autoplay + visibility.
